science.question: Across 29 source-matched native-forest transects on seven Azorean islands, do observed arthropod assemblages undergo substantial within-transect species replacement between B1 and B3, even when net species richness changes little? Does the pattern vary between original Spiders (Araneae) and Beetles (Coleoptera), pitfall vs beating, and endemic/native versus introduced taxa?
science.prior_art: Pozsgai et al (2026) Scientific Reports doi:10.1038/s41598-026-57146-5 already reported overall abundance, biomass and species-richness stability and species-specific increases/declines over BALA periods. These are baseline prior findings, not new Structural conclusions.
science.source_lineage: Independent original BALA 2024 published 7-island forest-transect observations, not the prior Terceira BioMonI 10-plot original data, and not newly withheld confirmatory response across geographies.

taxon_reader.original_Occurrence_foreign_coreid_sourc: meta.xml Occurrence coreid index0 -> source Event core primary id
taxon_reader.source_scientificName: stable original exact whitespace-normalized scientificName per taxon, collapse duplicate source Occurrence records within site×phase×method×guild
taxon_reader.other_taxon_ranks: source higher-rank/bulk records excluded from species/morphospecies target; report count, no posthoc new species-level heuristic
taxon_reader.canonicalization: Case-fold scientificName and normalize whitespace only, no opportunistic fuzzy synonyms
taxon_reader.qualifying_source_event_sample: Reconstruct ORIGINAL 29 site×2 method×3-phase min Event counts, select source primary event IDs lexicographically; must exactly match v1.313 source primaryID sha before reading first original species value

biogeographic_origin.other_source_values: unknown, ambiguous or blank. Do not impute, never relabel after biological outcome.

estimability.site_guild_qualified_if: At least one detected species-level operational taxon in B1 and B3 within same original transect and original source method; no outcome-selected exclusion for dissimilarity sign
estimability.if_guild_not_estimable: Report STOP for that guild/method independently without pursuing lower arbitrary minimum or different campaign.

fixed_scientific_stats.B2_use: secondary two intervals B1→B2 and B2→B3, unchanged source sites and methods, do not rechoose taxon filters or sample counts.
fixed_scientific_stats.core_site_guild_method_species_sets: S1, S3. Let a=|S1∩S3|, b=|S1\S3|, c=|S3\S1|. Species nondetection not treated as true local extinction/immigration.
fixed_scientific_stats.Sørensen_total_beta: (b+c)/(2a+b+c) for any nonempty pair of source site phase community species sets
fixed_scientific_stats.Simpson_replacement_beta: min(b,c)/(a+min(b,c)) (if a+min>0) as replacement component; richness/ nestedness Sorensen_total minus Simpson replacement
fixed_scientific_stats.balanced_species_replacement_incidence_s: 2*min(b,c)/(b+c) when changes; defined 0 when b=c=0; expresses how much of observed species entry+exit is balanced replacement, not net richness change
fixed_scientific_stats.net_richness_change: abs(|S3|-|S1|), and signed |S3|-|S1| reported separately from compositional dissimilarity
fixed_scientific_stats.primary: Ground PITFALL original method, Araneae and Coleoptera separately, average transect-level Simpson replacement / Sorensen total / balanced replacement share within each of seven islands, then island-equal-weight mean; report all seven islands, site n, and sign of guild differences without significance claim.
fixed_scientific_stats.secondary: Canopy beating method and B1→B2/B2→B3 interval, plus fixed endemic/native/introduced origin stratification only if original source ontology covers >=80% of eligible guild records.
fixed_scientific_stats.no_threshold_sign_chasing: Report raw effect direction and evidence counts regardless of whether replacement share exceeds 0.5; no model/period tuning after data access
fixed_scientific_stats.no_p_values: n=7 islands and 29 physical transects; no artificial 63,904 occurrence or 4,620 Event independent samples, source selection retrospective.

scientific_limits: Changes in source species detections are NOT actual confirmed local species extinctions or invasions
26-year discontinuous campaigns and effort standardization do not remove climate/seasonal/phenology/detection biases
Pitfall samples and canopy beating cannot be pooled as equal ecological methods
Some original taxa morphospecies and specimen code names may have identification drift

Same original BALA data underlies 2026 paper on aggregate abundance/ richness; species-replacement decomposition is separate estimand but not independent dataset for confirmation of authors' richness claims
Not causal environmental filter, predation interaction, island source rescue or colonization

firewall.source_outcome_opening: One fixed 2024 original Occurrence read after all physical Event hashes reconcile
